name: Runemaster Runic Breakout keeps Runeshroud abilities usable and instant after Runeshroud breaks (#497)
contract: Tooltip 705583: Runeshroud abilities can be used for 3 sec with no cast time after Runeshroud breaks.
The passive is a dummy aura; DBC helper 520767 'Runic Breakout (Proc)' lasts 3 sec (SpellDuration 27).
520767 reduces the cast time of Palm Sigils (family 38 mask2 0x2000) by 100%.
Palm Sigils require CasterAuraSpell 808089, the marker kept while Runeshroud 500288 is active.
Palm Sigil: Arcane 805380 normally has a 1.5 sec cast (SpellCastTimes 16).
With the talent, the marker and an instant Palm Sigil last 3 sec after Runeshroud breaks, then both end.
Without the talent the marker ends as soon as Runeshroud does.

steps.label: Let the characters settle
Runic Breakout passive is active
Palm Sigil: Arcane normally has a cast time
Runeshroud opens the Palm Sigil gate
Runeshroud breaks
Runeshroud is gone
Breaking Runeshroud grants the Runic Breakout window
The Runic Breakout window lasts 3 sec
Abilities requiring Runeshroud stay usable after it breaks
Palm Sigils have no cast time during the window
Palm Sigil: Arcane is cast instantly without Runeshroud
The Runic Breakout window expires
The Palm Sigil gate closes with the window
Palm Sigil: Arcane regains its cast time
Allow a full Palm Sigil cast
Palm Sigil fails once the window has closed
Control: Runeshroud opens the gate without the talent
Control: Runeshroud breaks
Control: Runeshroud is gone
Allow any proc to land
Control: no Runic Breakout window without the talent
Control: the gate closes as soon as Runeshroud breaks
